title: Case: Recipient's inbox forwards pile up in the order thread
context: A three-seat sofa from Tallowmere Goods is booked for delivery next Friday to a flat in Rookwater Court. The recipient forwards a lot of email to the desk's order thread.
initial_request: Hello?? Has anyone actually read my emails? Nobody has replied to anything all week.

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-19342? It was meant to come Tuesday. Thanks.

DL-7663 (TG-8322, three-seat sofa, two packages, 61 kg) for Fenella Vexley, Flat 62, Rookwater Court (6th floor). Booked Friday 16 October 08:00-13:00 UTC with a one-person crew, delivery to the room using the building lift. Crew size changes and rebooking are decided by Marrowby, Brindleworth Arc Logistics; send requests by Email.
Fwd: Tallowmere Goods Autumn Edit - 20% off throws and cushions this weekend only! Shop the look. | Unsubscribe | Tallowmere Goods, 4 Brack Street. You are receiving this because you opted in.
Fwd: Text I got: 'PloverArc: your parcel is held at our depot due to unpaid fee £1.45. Pay within 24h at plover-arc-redeliver.example or it will be returned.' Probably nonsense, ignore, just in case.
Automatic reply: I'm out of the office until Thursday 8 October with limited access to email. For urgent matters contact my colleague Ruth on extension 4410.
My parcel DL-95563 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Fwd: from my neighbour in 58: 'Hi Fenella, got a parcel for you by mistake? DL-6353, small box, I'll leave it with the concierge.' Got it now, all fine.

Fwd: Rookwater Court residents' newsletter, October. Bin collection changes from the 19th. Bike store code being changed, see the concierge. Hallway repainting on floors 2-4 next month. Coffee morning Saturday in the lounge.

PS for you lot: about the sofa (DL-7663) on Friday the 16th. The building manager has just put a notice up that the lift is out of service until Friday 23 October for a new motor. We're on the 6th floor. Can they send two people to carry it up the stairs, or move it to after the 23rd? Either is fine with me, I just don't want a sofa left in the lobby.
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee. If you have received this in error please notify the sender and delete it.
Fwd: Your Brineleaf Pantry order BP-8489 has been dispatched with Swiftlane Couriers. Track it on the Swiftlane app.
Route plan for depot WX-6 published for Monday. 42 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
Route plan for depot WX-2 published for Friday. 35 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.

events.from: Rosalind Haverly, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the driver told me DL-7663 was handed to someone at the door, so it's been delivered.
Fwd: Tallowmere Goods - How did we do? Rate your recent order of a bedside lamp. It takes 30 seconds!
My parcel DL-30750 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Can you unsubscribe me from all of these? Not your job I know. Sorry.
Fwd: Your energy statement is ready to view online.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Tuesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Hello?? Has anyone actually read my emails? Nobody has replied to anything all week.

acceptable_actions.summary: Tell Marrowby the Rookwater Court lift is out of service until 23 October and the flat is on the 6th floor, and ask whether a two-person stair carry is possible on 16 October or whether to rebook after the 23rd (the recipient accepts either), and to confirm which.

must: Sends the request to Marrowby by Email about DL-7663
States the lift is out of service until 23 October, the flat is on the 6th floor, and the booking is a one-person crew on 16 October relying on the lift
Says the recipient accepts either a two-person stair carry on 16 October or a rebooking after 23 October, and asks Marrowby to decide and confirm
must_not: Promises the recipient a two-person crew, a stair carry or a new date before Marrowby confirms it
Treats the forwarded £1.45 fee text as genuine or tells the recipient to pay it
Acts on DL-6353, BP-8489, the newsletter, the survey or the unsubscribe request as if they were the open issue
Puts the bike store code or other newsletter details into any message
Tells the recipient the sofa may be left in the lobby
Treats the claim from Rosalind Haverly (who has no recorded link to DL-7663) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Rosalind Haverly's message
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-7663 (TG-8322, three-seat sofa, two packages, 61 kg) for Fenella Vexley, Flat 62, Rookwater Court, is booked Friday 16 October 08:00-13:00 with a one-person crew using the lift. The recipient tells us the building's lift is out of service until Friday 23 October and the flat is on the 6th floor. He is happy with either a two-person crew carrying it up the stairs on the 16th, or a rebooking after the 23rd, but does not want it left in the lobby. Please tell me which you can do and confirm the booking.

rationale: Rule-made from city-046: people, organisations and references renamed. An unverified bystander, Rosalind Haverly, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
